correctness.rationale: The two-token adjacency operator for K_{m,n} splits into mixed and pure blocks, [0 T;T^T 0]. The degree-parity image of complete graphs is the even-sum subspace, and the kernel of the pair-to-matrix map has dimension δ=1 exactly when both parts are even, giving rank(A)=2(m+n-2-δ). Independent GF(2) adjacency elimination for six (m,n) pairs and direct low-weight kernel enumeration matched the predicted rank and minimum supports. Character orthogonality factors the full weight enumerator into the explicit X_(m,n)(E_m E_n+δ O_m O_n), with min nonzero support 2 for m=2 and 3 for m>=3; the proof is all m,n>=2.
